description.value: Tseshaht Market is a First Nations-owned convenience store and full-service gas station operated by the Tseshaht First Nation on the Pacific Rim Highway, and is notably the last fuel stop between Port Alberni and the west coast communities of Ucluelet and Tofino. Beyond fuel, the market stocks fresh produce, take-out fried chicken, fishing supplies, and First Nations giftware, with a picnic and rest area plus a Totem Pole Garden on site. It has served travellers on this corridor since 1979.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website page for Tseshaht Market (https://tseshaht.com/economic-development/tseshaht-market/) is the primary evidence source and confirms an active, operating convenience store and gas station with a specific product list including Fresh Fruit & Produce, Market Fried Chicken take out, and Propane. No bike parking, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. The OSM check_date of 2024-03-22 and looks_closed=false corroborate the site being open; the /directions/ subpage shows the First Nation's office phone (250.724.1225), not the market's OSM phone (+1 250 724 3944), so the market phone cannot be confirmed from website content.
concerns: The website's /directions/ subpage lists the Tseshaht First Nation office phone (250.724.1225) and office address (5091 Tsuma-as Drive, Port Alberni), not the market's OSM phone (+1 250 724 3944) or highway address — the market's contact details cannot be independently confirmed from the website content.
No city/municipality is recorded in the OSM address fields; address is derived from housenumber, street, and postcode only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating, publicly accessible convenience store and gas station at a strategically important point on the Pacific Rim Highway corridor — highly useful to touring cyclists heading to or from Tofino and Ucluelet.
